title: Orna portable sys API

invariants: preserves the row natural key and resolution context
does not grant authority
live references are runtime-generation-bound
value_types.name: sys.RowRef<T>
value_types.purpose: Snapshot/runtime-pinned reference to one canonical system-relation row.

invariants: is not a dynamic Any fallback
retains the exact originating static type
cannot be implicitly unboxed or converted
value_types.name: sys.Value
value_types.purpose: Explicit existential envelope for a value crossing a reflective system boundary.

value_types.name: sys.Argument
value_types.purpose: One named typed reflective-call argument.

invariants: names are unique
canonical order is Unicode scalar-value order by name
record literals are boxed only under an ArgumentMap expected type
value_types.name: sys.ArgumentMap
value_types.purpose: Immutable ordered collection of uniquely named reflective-call arguments.

value_types.name: sys.ValueMetadata<T>
value_types.purpose: Safe type, protocol and codec metadata for a value without private-field disclosure.

invariants: resumable is false in 1.0
usable only by sys.await and sys.cancel
descriptive decoding never revives operational authority
value_types.name: sys.InvocationHandle<T>
value_types.purpose: Operational handle for one accepted invocation in one runtime generation.

invariants: status is terminal
succeeded has value and no failure
failed has failure and no value
cancelled/orphaned have no value and may carry a diagnostic
value_types.name: sys.InvocationResult<T>
value_types.purpose: Complete terminal result returned by sys.await.

value_types.name: sys.ExpressionRef
value_types.purpose: Snapshot-pinned reference to a resolved expression in a definition.

invariants: 0 <= start_byte <= end_byte
line and column values are one-based
value_types.name: sys.SourceSpan
value_types.purpose: Half-open canonical UTF-8 source range with one-based human coordinates.

value_types.name: sys.SourceMapEntry
value_types.purpose: Mapping from a generated span to an authored span and optional original name.

value_types.name: sys.DiagnosticLabel
value_types.purpose: One source label attached to a structured diagnostic.

invariants: text and unavailable_reason are not both absent
text hashes to exact_hash after canonical decoding
value_types.name: sys.SourceDocument
value_types.purpose: Exact retained source plus source maps and explicit unavailability state.

value_types.name: sys.Attribution
value_types.purpose: Source or semantic blame attribution for one exact target range.

value_types.name: sys.PersonIdentity
value_types.purpose: Git-compatible authored identity without signing or authorization semantics.

value_types.name: sys.ObjectDescription
value_types.purpose: Structured summary of one semantic object at its pinned revision.

value_types.name: sys.Explanation
value_types.purpose: Structured causal explanation of a diagnostic.

invariants: payload is not generically orderable
equality includes format and canonical payload
provider APIs own construction and comparison beyond equality
value_types.name: sys.CheckpointPosition
value_types.purpose: Provider-specific replay position with portable equality and canonical encoding.

value_types.name: sys.CompatibilityInfo
value_types.purpose: Compatibility tuple embedded in builds and artifacts.

value_types.name: sys.RuntimeInfo
value_types.purpose: Exact language, sys, storage, presentation and implementation coordinates for the current runtime.

invariants: semantic_changes is zero
value_types.name: sys.FlushResult
value_types.purpose: Result of sealing durable pending rows without a logical data change.

invariants: semantic_changes is zero
value_types.name: sys.CompactionResult
value_types.purpose: Result of an atomic physical segment compaction.

invariants: semantic_diff is empty
generation is published only after complete verification
value_types.name: sys.StorageRewriteResult
value_types.purpose: Result of a generation-CAS rewrite between editable and compact physical representations.

value_types.name: sys.PublicationPolicy
value_types.purpose: Effective compact publication target, file bound and maximum pending age.

invariants: invalid has at least one error/fatal diagnostic
valid has no error/fatal diagnostic
value_types.name: sys.VerificationReport
value_types.purpose: Structured integrity-verification outcome.

value_types.name: sys.CancellationView
value_types.purpose: Immutable activation-local cancellation observation.

value_types.name: sys.PresentationOverride
value_types.purpose: Session-local presentation selection for one type.

value_types.name: sys.Watch
value_types.purpose: REPL watch expression and its most recent safe observation.

value_types.name: sys.DatabaseView
value_types.purpose: Current attached database/worktree descriptor exposed by sys.database.

value_types.name: sys.CurrentContext
value_types.purpose: Immutable context of the current activation exposed by sys.current.

value_types.name: sys.RuntimeView
value_types.purpose: Current live runtime owner and live relation handles exposed by sys.rt.

value_types.name: sys.ReplView
value_types.purpose: Interactive session presentation and watch state exposed by sys.repl.

invariants: object: only object is present; file: only file is present; row: only table and row_key are present
row_key retains a non-secret key type and canonical value
equality includes kind and all populated identity fields
value_types.name: sys.ChangeTarget
value_types.purpose: Discriminated identity of one changed semantic object, source file or table row.

invariants: reason is divergent_position, incompatible_format, or delete_update
opaque positions are never numerically ordered
value_types.name: sys.CheckpointConflict
value_types.purpose: A three-way merge conflict between incomparable or divergent checkpoint positions.

invariants: absence means no row, not a row with null fields
reason is update_update, delete_update, key_collision, or assertion_failure
value_types.name: sys.RowConflict
value_types.purpose: A three-way merge conflict at one stable table identity and primary key.

invariants: token is a domain-separated digest of all plan inputs in canonical order
the plan performs no mutation
force is not permission to accept a stale token
value_types.name: sys.CheckoutPlan
value_types.purpose: Read-only preview bound to the exact target and local worktree state.
